items.summary: The pinned TUI profile does not import the complete model Tool/Preset declaration used by the native data-agent scope.
Agent preset standing-scope composition remains a native DSH contract.
The dataAgentConnections and Catalog Cordis service faces have no admitted Community v0.15 service definition.
HTTP routes remain owned by the native Web bundle row.
Web slots remain owned by the native browser client.
The durable data_agent_connections and data_agent_catalog domains remain owned by native Cordis storage-domain.
Credential references resolve only inside the existing native runtime and are excluded from evidence.
Database execution remains native and depends on packaged or external database clients.
The masked local TTY form is preserved but is not standard Presentation evidence.

UserInteraction is intentionally not declared: Community v0.15 contract rows cannot carry the requirement spec required by the pinned dsh-std protocol definition, and declaring it prevents actual adapter activation.
Native Cordis effects are implementation evidence, not standard activation-owned ledger effects.
Repository Host Descriptors are fixtures and cannot establish real-host compatibility.
Local, remote, attach/detach, and multiple-Presentation parity has not been observed on a real Host.
No external signer or governance attestation is present.
